hook: HC orders DGP to produce *HYDRAA chief* on Nov 17
hook_b: HC orders DGP to produce *HYDRAA chief* on Nov 17
tldr: Justice CV Bhaskar Reddy dismissed exemption pleas in two contempt cases over land in Shamshabad and Bachupally.

beats.what: HYDRAA commissioner AV Ranganath and the Shamshabad tahsildar must appear on Nov 17; the Medchal-Malkajgiri Collector on Nov 25.
beats.why: In both cases petitioners say officials acted on land despite earlier court orders, and filed contempt petitions.
beats.care: The rulings test how far HYDRAA's land and lake actions must follow court process.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI: both HYDRAA's chief and the tahsildar had been told on Oct 13 to appear on Nov 11, and neither was present.

cards.q: Should senior officials appear in person when a court summons them?

qs: What happens if an official still does not appear after the police are told to ensure it?
How many HYDRAA actions are being challenged in court right now?

facts.t: The Shamshabad case is over *43,560 sq yards* (about 9 acres) on the prohibited-properties list.
The Medchal Collector sought exemption citing *election-related duties*; the court said official work is no excuse.
